issue_context.title: Create repo on push allows invalid names with slashes
issue_context.body:
<!-- NOTE: If your issue is a security concern, please send an email to security@gitea.io instead of opening a public issue -->

<!--
    1. Please speak English, this is the language all maintainers can speak and write.
    2. Please ask questions or configuration/deploy problems on our Discord 
       server (https://discord.gg/gitea) or forum (https://discourse.gitea.io).
    3. Please take a moment to check that your issue doesn't already exist.
    4. Please give all relevant information below for bug reports, because 
       incomplete details will be handled as an invalid report.
-->

- Gitea version (or commit ref): 1.11.0+rc2-17-g0129e76ef
- Git version: 2.20.1
- Operating system: Debian
- Database (use `[x]`):
  - [ ] PostgreSQL
  - [ ] MySQL
  - [ ] MSSQL
  - [x] SQLite
- Can you reproduce the bug at https://try.gitea.io:
  - [ ] Yes (provide example URL)
  - [x] No ("Push to create is not enabled for users." and "Push to create is not enabled for organizations.")
  - [ ] Not relevant
- Log gist:

## Description
With `ENABLE_PUSH_CREATE_USER`, all of this works fine from the command line:
```bash
git init test
cd test
echo hi > README.md
git add README.md
git commit -m 'Initial commit'
git remote add origin git@git.example.com:jim/foo/bar/test.git
git push --set-upstream origin master     # this works
git pull     # this works
cd ..
git clone git@git.example.com:jim/foo/bar/test.git test2     # this works
```
And things look OK at first glance in the UI...

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/204930/73789389-b19b3380-476c-11ea-8650-826761b72c53.png)

or 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/204930/73789854-8533e700-476d-11ea-922c-c2a25b12d3d3.png)

**But** clicking on the repo pops up a browser auth prompt:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/204930/73789544-02129100-476d-11ea-9092-988cccdecee5.png)

followed by a page saying just "invalid credentials".

I don't even know how to delete this repo now.  Related to #9175 I assume.
comments: Removing the repo from disk and the single corresponding row in the `repositories` table seems to have gotten rid of it cleanly.

review_comments:
It feel that this should belong somewhere in models package or in modules/validation/.
But that a more global problem that input validation are scattered across gitea code.

I agree, when writing this I felt like it would be nice to have a central validation method, but when I looked this validation is actually in Macaron code and we use a binding for it.  
I think there's one other place that uses this pattern, but I forget what for off the top of my head.
